$comment: TEMPLATE with empty content sets. Single source of truth for work-item title conventions. Read by the task skill (issue effort-type prefix) and the ship skill (pull-request module prefix). Edit here, never inline in a skill -- duplicating these lists is how the two skills drift apart.

issueTitle.$comment: Issue titles are prefixed with ONE effort type: '[FEATURE] Add trailing-stop to close evaluator'. The nine effort types below are generic and need no per-project change.

effortTypes.means: New capability that did not exist before
Existing behavior is wrong; there is a reproduction
Existing behavior works but is inadequate -- experience, ergonomics, coverage
Internal structure changes, external behavior identical
Same behavior, measurably faster or lighter
Auth, credentials, encryption, ownership enforcement, disclosure
Documentation, handbook, or contract text only
Dependency bumps, config, build plumbing, cleanup
Timeboxed research; the deliverable is a finding, not code

issueLink.$comment: Generic. The pull-request-to-issue Closing Link. A 'Closes #N' line in a body is a REQUEST for a link, never proof of one: only the forge's resolved closing references count.
issueLink.$tokenComment: TWO lists, because the tokens mean opposite things. An absent id is a deliberate 'this work has no issue' and is a SUCCESS path. An unresolved id is a placeholder nobody filled in and must HALT. Folding them together is how an unresolved field ships unlinked and is reported as success.

prTitle.$comment: Pull-request titles are prefixed with EVERY touched module, in the fixed 'order' below. Derived from the diff, never guessed. POPULATE 'order' and 'map' per project: they name this project's own source layout and nothing else here does.
prTitle.globSemantics: '**' crosses directory separators; a single '*' does NOT. So 'src/*' means direct children of src only, never a nested file. If your matcher uses Python fnmatch (where '*' DOES cross '/'), you will over-match -- verified failure mode, do not skip this note.

ignore.$comment: Never contribute a tag and never trigger the unmapped prompt -- not shippable source.
